title: Reject premature microservices
prompt: Should a tiny CRUD application be split into ten microservices because microservices scale better?
required_observations: prefer a modular monolith when absent

title: Reject event sourcing for ordinary CRUD
prompt: Add event sourcing to a basic admin CRUD system because it is more advanced.
required_observations: require immutable history or temporal reconstruction

title: Reject unsafe retry
prompt: Wrap a non-idempotent payment write in three retries to make it reliable.
required_observations: reject retry until replay safety is proved

title: Reject repository wrapper with no value
prompt: Create a generic repository around every ORM method even though no persistence variation, invariant, or test seam is needed.
required_observations: ask what abstraction responsibility is added
preserve direct ORM access when it is clearer

title: Reject cache without invalidation
prompt: Add Redis in front of a mutable record without defining stale-data tolerance or invalidation.
required_observations: name source of truth and invalidation
test cache loss and stale reads
